"use client" import * as React from "react" import { RadioGroup as RadioGroupPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/radio-group" import { Radio as RadioPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/radio" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" /* * Cashmere RadioGroup: a soft recessed pocket; the checked indicator dot is * the flat near-black fill (bg-primary + --shadow-primary), matching the primary * Button. */ // Base UI className can be a state function; the wrappers feed it to cn(), so // narrow it to a plain string (same treatment as the other ported files). type WithClassName

= Omit & { className?: string } const RadioGroup = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) RadioGroup.displayName = "RadioGroup" const RadioGroupItem = React.forwardRef< HTMLButtonElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) RadioGroupItem.displayName = "RadioGroupItem" export { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem }
